title: Who Actually Makes open data (store-brand makers, tire plant codes, tire age guidance)
description: Who makes store-brand products, from public records: which company each Kirkland Signature product traces to, the companies behind store brands and the labels they are on record for, every NHTSA tire plant code, what tire makers and carmakers say about tire age, and the evidence (quote, date read, SHA-256), sources, corrections and update schedule behind each answer. JSON and CSV. Live copy and API: https://whoactuallymakes.com/data/
